New ONS figures out this month: 30% of UK businesses use at least one AI technology, and 38% of those with 10 or more staff.

So most businesses haven't started yet. One well-chosen use is enough to begin, and it's usually less work than people expect.

Source: ONS Business Insights and Conditions Survey, wave 165 (published 8 October 2026).
ig:
New ONS figures: 3 in 10 UK businesses now use at least one AI technology (38% of firms with 10+ staff).

Read the other way round: most businesses haven't started. You don't need a big programme to be early. One well-chosen use (answering routine customer questions, drafting documents, cleaning up data) is a real start.

Source: ONS Business Insights and Conditions Survey, wave 165, published 8 Oct 2026.

li:
The ONS published its latest Business Insights figures on 8 October: 30% of UK businesses reported using at least one AI technology in September 2026. For businesses with 10 or more employees, it was 38%. For the largest firms, around half.

Two takeaways for SME leaders:
→ Most of your competitors haven't started either. Being early is still possible.
→ The gap with larger firms is real. They're building habits now.

Our advice is the same as always: pick one narrow, measurable use \(routine customer questions, document drafting, data clean-up\) and get it working properly before doing anything bigger.

Source: ONS, Business insights and impact on the UK economy, 8 October 2026.
